bio.short: I help businesses replace manual, complex, repetitive, and error-prone spreadsheet workflows with Automated Excel Systems — installed as branded Ribbon add-ins that ship with documented SOPs and 30–45 days of post-delivery support.
long: Most businesses don't have a data problem. They have a clarity problem. MIS Reports get stitched together by hand every month, formulas get patched, repetitive processes consume hours, and one day nobody trusts the numbers anymore. That's what Altorz fixes.

I'm the founder of Altorz — a boutique Excel consulting practice, serving businesses across India. Every system I ship arrives inside a branded Excel add-in — the Altorz Ribbon™ — deployed directly into your team's Excel environment, with one-click access to the automation and a documented SOP so your team can run it without me.

By day I run data and operations for a B2B manufacturing firm — which is exactly how I learned, firsthand, how broken spreadsheet workflows cripple real businesses. By evening and weekend, I rebuild them for Altorz clients. I work to one rule: production-grade, not prototype-grade.
